english: Each decision is a row the game core wrote the moment it was taken (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); the names in `…` are the codes of playerbot_explain_rules.h and the overlay's constants. An equipment change: the pass puts on a piece whose score (TERM_TOTAL) beats the worn one's by SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE per mille, and a piece it took off within the hour only by SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT percent. A weapon's score is its blow x1000 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, the model of GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt: the attack grade on foot, the weapon's roll, the plus's attack, a monster's defence at the bot's level, average and skill damage, mt2009's hidden bonus by the weapon's level) with Iwakura's tier on the blow alone, and beside it the class's preference and the fixed lines; the rest of the gear's is defence, lines and stones times the family's tier. A counter line: the price's steps in the order the pricing takes them - Iwakura's sheet at the yang rate and the inflation, the lines, the sale memory, the market ledger, the step limit, the keeper's spread, the floors, the rounding. The flags are the core's, the anomalies the panel's.
polski: Każda decyzja to wiersz zapisany przez rdzeń gry w chwili jej podjęcia (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); nazwy w `…` to kody z playerbot_explain_rules.h i stałe nakładki. Zmiana ekwipunku: przegląd zakłada rzecz, której wynik (TERM_TOTAL) przewyższa noszoną o SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE promili, a rzecz zdjętą w ciągu godziny dopiero o SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT procent. Wynik broni to jej cios ×1000 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, model GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt: stopień ataku na piechotę, rzut broni, atak z plusa, obrona potwora na poziomie bota, średnie obrażenia i obrażenia umiejętności, ukryty bonus poziomu broni mt2009) ze stopniem Iwakury tylko na ciosie, i obok preferencja klasy i stałe bonusy; reszty ekwipunku — obrona, bonusy i kamienie razy stopień rodziny. Linia lady: kroki ceny w kolejności wyceny — arkusz Iwakury ze stawką yang i inflacją, bonusy, pamięć sprzedaży, rejestr rynku, ogranicznik kroku, rozrzut sprzedawcy, progi, zaokrąglenie. Flagi zapisał rdzeń, anomalie wyliczył panel.
translation: Each decision is a row the game core wrote the moment it was taken (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); the names in `…` are the codes of playerbot_explain_rules.h and the overlay's constants. An equipment change: the pass puts on a piece whose score (TERM_TOTAL) beats the worn one's by SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE per mille, and a piece it took off within the hour only by SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT percent. A weapon's score is its blow x1000 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, the model of GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt: the attack grade on foot, the weapon's roll, the plus's attack, a monster's defense at the bot's level, average and skill damage, mt2009's hidden bonus by the weapon's level) with Iwakura's tier on the blow alone, and beside it the class's preference and the fixed lines; the rest of the gear's is defense, lines and stones times the family's tier. A counter line: the price's steps in the order the pricing takes them - Iwakura's sheet at the yang rate and the inflation, the lines, the sale memory, the market ledger, the step limit, the keeper's spread, the floors, the rounding. The flags are the core's, the anomalies the panel's.

english: The Apprentice Chest chain (from Apprentice Chest I to the Grand Master Chest: potions, elixirs, green stones and the next chest) - one switch for players and bots. On: a player's new character gets it at its first login (up to level 5), a bot has its own from the start and opens the next chests at their levels. Off: nobody gets it; the bots lose the unopened chests of the chain and new bots are made without one. Players' chests are never touched. A change is live at once and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_STARTER_CHEST in .env).
polski: Łańcuch Skrzyń Ucznia (od Skrzyni Ucznia I po Skrzynię Arcymistrza: mikstury, eliksiry, zielone kamienie i następna skrzynia) — jeden przełącznik dla graczy i botów. Włączona: nowa postać gracza dostaje ją przy pierwszym logowaniu (do 5. poziomu), bot ma swoją od początku i otwiera kolejne skrzynie na ich poziomach. Wyłączona: nie dostaje jej nikt; boty tracą nieotwarte skrzynie z łańcucha, a nowe boty rodzą się bez niej. Skrzyń graczy nic nie rusza. Zmiana działa od razu i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_STARTER_CHEST w .env).

english: The official rule (the default): every point from 17 to 19 is another roll for Master - at 17 one chance in four, at 18 in three, at 19 in two - and the 20th point is a sure M1, so a skill costs 17 to 20 points and never gets stuck. The old rule (since 2.2.14): one roll at the 17th point (25%, 45% below level 35, +25% for every reset at the Old Woman); a failed one leaves the skill at 17 at every level, and only a Book of Oblivion, the Skill Reset Scroll or the Old Woman (up to level 30) move it on. Under both, the scroll makes the next 17th point a sure Master. Bots and the Companion play the same rule. Changes are live without a restart and survive the next start until you change this option in the launcher (Difficulty, M2_SKILL_STUCK_17).
polski: Oficjalna zasada (domyślnie): każdy punkt od 17 do 19 to kolejny rzut na Mistrza - przy 17 jedna szansa na cztery, przy 18 na trzy, przy 19 na dwie - a 20. punkt daje M1 na pewno, więc umiejętność kosztuje od 17 do 20 punktów i nigdy nie utyka. Stara zasada (od 2.2.14): jeden rzut przy 17. punkcie (25%, 45% poniżej 35 poziomu, +25% za każdy reset u Starszej Pani); po porażce umiejętność stoi na 17 na każdym poziomie, a dalej prowadzi tylko Księga Zapomnienia, Zwój Powrotu Umiejętności albo Starsza Pani (do 30 poziomu). W obu zasadach zwój daje pewnego Mistrza przy następnym 17. punkcie. Boty i Towarzysz grają tą samą zasadą. Zmiana działa na żywo bez restartu i zostaje po ponownym starcie, dopóki nie zmienisz tej opcji w launcherze (Poziom trudności, M2_SKILL_STUCK_17).

english: On by default: the owner of a companion may play it himself as an ordinary player (the P window, Management, "Play your companion") and go back to his own character with "Back to your character" or /towarzysz wroc; a logout or a login of the owner's account ends it as well. Only in a world on this computer with COOP off - on a VPS and for friends the server refuses, unless "Public servers" below is on. A GM character cannot. Tylko w świecie na tym komputerze z wyłączonym COOP — na VPS i u znajomych serwer odmawia, chyba że włączysz poniżej „Serwery publiczne”. Postać GM nie może. Zmiana działa od razu i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz M2_SIDEKICK_PLAY w .env.

english: How often weapons and armour (jewellery, boots, helmets and shields too) dropped by monsters come with bonuses, and how many: a percent of the game's own chance, 100% = as in the game. It changes the chance of the first bonus and of the second and third - three at most, as in the game, and their values stay the same. In the game weapons from ordinary monsters have no bonuses (only from Metin stones, bosses and chiefs); above 100% they get them at the item's own chance times the excess (at 200% what its table says). Monster drops only - shops, quest rewards, chests and the ItemShop stay as they are. The bots drop bonused gear more often too and put it on their stalls. A change applies from the next drop, without a restart, and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DROP_BONUS_PCT in .env).

english: The game takes part of the drop chance from a character above its monster: two levels over 98% of the chance is left, five over 92%, ten over half (a boss and a Metin stone 30%), fifteen and more over 1%. This setting is the least share of the chance a kill keeps whatever the level difference: 0% = the game's own penalty (the default), 100% = no penalty, anything between a floor (at 25% a character fifteen levels over drops at a quarter of the chance). It never lowers a chance, so a character under its monster or at its level drops as before, and the drop rate and the drop bonuses act on the result as they always did. It covers the whole drop of a kill - items, drop groups, Metin stones, bosses and books - for players and bots alike; yang and experience stay as they are. The client Wiki's note on the level penalty describes the game without this setting. A change applies from the next kill, without a restart, and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DROP_LEVEL_FLOOR_PCT in .env).

To ustawienie to najmniejsza część szansy, jaką zabicie zachowuje bez względu na różnicę poziomów: 0% = kara jak w grze (domyślnie), 100% = bez kary, pomiędzy = podłoga (przy 25% postać 15 poziomów wyżej dropi z jedną czwartą szansy). Nigdy nie obniża szansy, więc postać niższa od potwora albo na jego poziomie dropi jak dotąd, a stawka dropu i bonusy do dropu działają na wynik jak zawsze. Dotyczy całego dropu z zabicia — przedmiotów, grup dropu, Metinów, bossów i ksiąg — u graczy i botów tak samo; yang i doświadczenie bez zmian. Notatka o karze za poziom w Wiki klienta opisuje grę bez tego ustawienia. Zmiana działa od następnego zabicia, bez restartu, i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_DROP_LEVEL_FLOOR_PCT w .env).

english: How fast the players' characters and the bots move, the Companion with them: a percent of the game's own speed, 100% = as in the game. It goes on top of everything the game gives - gear, skills, potions, a sprint, a horse or a mount - on foot and in the saddle; the client takes at most 255 (2.55 times a character with nothing on, 100), so a fast character reaches that ceiling sooner. The bots move at the same pace as the players, and the Companion keeps up with its player; monsters move as in the game. The character window shows the speed with this percent (at 50% a character of 120 reads 60). A change applies at once to everyone in the game, without a restart, and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_MOVE_SPEED_PCT in .env).
polski: Jak szybko poruszają się postacie graczy i boty, a z nimi Towarzysz: procent szybkości z gry, 100% = jak w grze. Boty chodzą w tym samym tempie co gracze, a Towarzysz nadąża za swoim graczem; potwory poruszają się jak w grze. Okno postaci pokazuje szybkość z tym procentem (przy 50% postać ze 120 ma 60). Zmiana działa od razu u wszystkich w grze, bez restartu, i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_MOVE_SPEED_PCT w .env).

Channel 1 and channel 2 hand the role out apart, so 5 a village is 30 bots on CH1 and 30 on CH2; the droppers of CH2 serve their stands on CH1, as the other sellers of CH2 do. english: How many Cor Draconis a day the Power of the Dragon Eye gives at the Alchemist (10 = as in the game; one fewer on the day of the first hand-in) and the extra drops of Metin stones and bosses for players, as a percent of kills (0 = off): Dragon Stones (1-5 shards from a Metin by its level, a Cor Draconis from a boss, two from the strongest; from level 30 and only with the Alchemy on) and Kupon SM (10 to 500 Dragon Coins by the Metin's level, a value or two more from a boss, up to 5000 from the strongest of level 105; the smaller ones more often, so a kill is worth as many coins on average as before). A change is live at once and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DS_EYES_PER_DAY, M2_EXTRA_DS_DROP and M2_EXTRA_COUPON_DROP in .env).

english: The Alchemist in every kingdom's first village: from level 30 a letter to him, shards from monsters, Cor Draconis and the Alchemy window (the button in the inventory and the O key). On: it works for players and bots. Off: nobody gets the letter, a shard or a Cor Draconis, the Alchemist has none of his options, the bots take no part, and a player's client hides the Alchemy button in the inventory and opens no window on O; the stones and boxes a character holds stay its own. english: How many game channels the server runs. With two, some of the bots play on CH2, so the server spreads them over two CPU cores and carries more bots at once. Every shop, bots' and players', stands on CH1: a bot on CH2 that wants to open or serve its shop or to buy something moves to CH1, and a free bot of CH1 moves to CH2 in its place. The share set here is the least CH2 carries; with nobody waiting to move, CH2 may take up to ten points more. With three and four, CH3 (and CH4) carry fresh bots from level one besides: characters of their own, 500 a kingdom, made at the first start with this setting. They never move to CH1 or CH2, and the bots of CH1 and CH2 never come to theirs; there are no shops, bot guilds, wars, tower or events on CH3 and CH4. One channel by default.
polski: Ile kanałów gry uruchamia serwer. Przy dwóch część botów gra na CH2, więc serwer rozkłada je na dwa rdzenie procesora i udźwignie więcej botów naraz. Wszystkie sklepy (botów i graczy) stoją tylko na CH1: bot z CH2, który chce otworzyć albo obsłużyć swój sklep albo coś kupić, przechodzi na CH1, a wolny bot z CH1 przechodzi na jego miejsce na CH2. Ustawiony udział to najmniej tyle botów na CH2; gdy nikt nie czeka na przejście, CH2 może przejąć do 10 punktów więcej. Przy trzech i czterech na CH3 (i CH4) grają do tego świeże boty od 1 poziomu: osobne postacie, po 500 na królestwo, tworzone przy pierwszym starcie z tym ustawieniem. Nie przechodzą na CH1 i CH2, a boty z CH1 i CH2 nie przychodzą do nich; na CH3 i CH4 nie ma sklepów, gildii botów, wojen, Wieży ani wydarzeń. Domyślnie jeden kanał.

With three and four, CH3 (and CH4) carry fresh bots from level one besides: characters of their own, 500 a kingdom, made at the first start with this setting.
